newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bond spreads edge in vs U.S.,Canada.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bond spreads edge in vs U.S.,Canada.

text.p: A late short squeeze in Australian bonds helped the market reverse an early widening bias in yield spreads against both U.S. and Canadian debt, traders said.
Spreads against North American debt have slowly edged tighter in the last couple of days, having blown out sharply after Tuesday's unexpectedly strong rise in July retail sales.
However, the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread still remains above Monday's low of around 115 basis points, its lowest level in over two years.
The U.S. market continues to fret over today's U.S. non-farm payrolls, which if strong, could force the Federal Reserve to tighten policy at the FOMC meeting on September 24.
This also weighed on Canadian bonds.
